note: Describes a generative biome manifest in assets/biomes/<id>.json. See tools/generate_all_biomes.py and README.md.

id.note: Biome identifier; must start with 'biome_' and match ^biome_[a-z0-9_]+$. Used as the manifest filename.

name.note: Human-readable biome name shown in the editor sidebar.

priority.note: Placement priority (0-100). Higher wins during world generation, so rivers/ponds override hills/meadow.

description.note: Short prose description of the biome's terrain and dressing.

color_hex.note: Legend/map color as a #rrggbb hex string.

noise.note: Noise shape used to place the patch: frequency, octaves (1-8), persistence, threshold, and dither_bandwidth for soft edges.

elevation.note: Elevation shaping in METERS (1 unit = 1 m): base_offset_m, noise_amplitude_m, noise_frequency, max_slope_deg.

generative_ground.note: Ground shading: shader_mode, primary/secondary/slope colors, pattern_scale (meters), pattern_intensity, normal_micro_roughness.
